packageRules.description: Media stack: group all updates into a single PR
Frequent releases: check as soon as detected, patches auto-merge

OpenClaw: releases several times a week and the image is pinned, so the default Monday-only window plus the shared hourly PR budget kept it permanently at the back of the queue (no PR for ~2 months). Never auto-merge: the model registry is baked into the image and a bump can drop model ids the config depends on.
Security components: always require manual review
Major versions: require manual approval from Dependency Dashboard
zigbee2mqtt: migrates its own config schema on every version bump (can break HA discovery) — check each release individually, never auto-merge, always review changelog before bumping

Updates that restart Postgres. The exporter is a sidecar in the Postgres pod, and operator or Spilo bumps change the StatefulSet, so the operator recreates the single pod. On 2026-10-09 an exporter bump took Postgres down for ~6 min, and with it Authelia (SSO), n8n, Homebox and the HA recorder. Never auto-merge, not even patches: merge alone, at a chosen time. The title suffix reaches the Telegram notification. Spilo is matched by pattern in case Renovate starts tracking it.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Merging this restarts Postgres.** The operator recreates `postgres-cluster-0`: about 3–6 minutes without a database, so Authelia (SSO), n8n, Homebox and the Home Assistant recorder are down too. Merge it **on its own**, not together with other PRs, at a time when that is acceptable. `PostgresqlNotResponding` will fire on Telegram and resolve by itself.

packageRules.description: Longhorn: its admission webhook validates every PVC update in the cluster (failurePolicy Fail) and is unavailable while longhorn-manager restarts. On 2026-10-07 a Homarr upgrade merged a minute after a Longhorn upgrade hit that window, and its HelmRelease stalled until reset by hand. Never auto-merge; merge alone.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Merge this on its own.** Upgrading Longhorn restarts its admission webhook, and while it is down every PVC change in the cluster fails. Wait for the `longhorn` HelmRelease to be Ready before merging anything else. Afterwards, the volumes keep their old engine until it is upgraded on purpose.
